title: pretty good
date: Reviewed in the United States on December 21, 2025
review: I have bought lots of these types of products in the past, so I may be a little extra critical.  These work just as well as any and come with all the extras I like (the green sticks to stick them in the dirt are my favorite).  I like that they don't have the triangle under the shape - that never works for sticking it in the dirt and look silly if you would rather hang them.  The little shovel is worthless and they should save the plastic.I bought this set because my previous favorites are no longer available and these seemed to be the closest thing.  What makes them not as good - the paper is MUCH harder to get off these!  I hate fighting with them and getting them stuck to my fingers.  The shapes aren't as cute as those I've had before.  The mushroom and bird are fine, the bug and butterfly are from a strange angle and look weird.OK, but I'll look for something else next time.
